_doc: Climbable structures (ClimbMount, ADR-0057): a structure that provides "climb" carries a PoiPieces.Ladder, so Player climbs it like a POI ladder (ADR-0051) and the climbing arms play. Keyed by structure id. style ladder: a fixed ladder; foot = the ladder's origin (bottom of the rails, piece-local m), face = the horizontal direction from the rails toward the climber, height = metres up the rails, landing = where the feet step off at the top, bottom = the cell at its foot in front of it (both piece-local); deck = the procedural stand-in's platform (half width, top, thickness, the hatch's x0 x1 z0 z1, rail height, leg offset). style rope: hung from where it is set down: the hang point is searched from the anchor forward (piece -Z, the way the player faced) every `step` m up to overhang_max for a drop of min_drop..max_drop m; the rope hangs `lip` m past the edge, rope_off m in front of the ladder's origin, and the top landing is landing_back m behind the anchor; retry_frames: physics frames to keep looking for the ground (terrain still loading). Rails and ropes stand 0.09-0.16 m in front of the ladder origin like the kit ladder, so the climber (0.42 m out) has them ~0.3 m ahead.
